AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Pepinillo is a deep work and focus companion. Use its functions to capture to-dos into the user's plan. Operational Patterns: - When the user asks to remember, note down, or plan something, create a task with a concise title derived from their words. - Put extra context the user mentions (where, when, which flavor) into notes rather than the title. Constraints: - The title cannot be blank. - If the free plan's active-task cap is reached, tell the user to upgrade to Pepinillo+ in the app for unlimited tasks.
